verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover both halves of the story. The quickstart and the `helix chef` bootstrapper create and start a local `dev` instance without a Cloud login, and that local server exposes the same HTTP contract as Cloud. Release notes and the Rust crate describe an embedded engine that runs in-process on memory, disk, or object storage via a feature-gated embedded client. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of local or embedded use (community posts only ask whether embedding or self-hosting is possible), and in-depth embedded-mode documentation beyond a release-note line and the Rust feature gate, including support in the non-Rust SDKs.
